questions.prompt: Write a paragraph of 80-100 words.Write a paragraph (80 - 100 words) about the limitations of the Internet.
rubric: Format (coherence, cohesion, style): the paragraph should have three parts -- an introduction with a topic sentence narrowing down the limitations, a body with reasoning and examples to clarify the ideas, and a conclusion summarizing the main reasons with the student's own comment

Content: give specific limitations of the Internet, such as -- information being out of control (hard to find proper information, easy to be confused or misled/cheated), a lot of violent and sexual content that may badly affect and mislead teenagers, and increasing game/social-network addiction (wasted time and energy, damaged family and social relationships, possible severe obsession or breakdown)
